new_statements.quote: There is a meaningful contrastive accent in Masbatenyo. Accent, or stress, is manifested as length on the vowel nucleus of open syllables, but in closed syllables, prominence usually consists of voice emphasis, or loudness. A pitch difference is not consistent. Accent is written as ['] before the vowel to be stressed in the following examples, but is not written in literature outside the dictionary. Compare the following pairs, for example: kita [k'ita] 'see' kita [kit'a] 'we inclusive' ubos ['ubos] 'depleted' ubos [ub'os] 'lower area'

new_statements.relation_note: The the published catalog (site_bib) codes masb1238 as lexical from Rosero 2011 (phonemic stress on final or penult, duration the main cue). The target JSON's catalog_records row shows an empty rule string, but the held catalog classification is lexical. Wolfenden 2001 agrees: contrastive accent shown by penult-vs-ultima minimal pairs, cued by length. It adds detail that Rosero does not (loudness rather than length in closed syllables, pitch not consistent, accent unmarked in the practical orthography, existence of morphophonemic accent shift) but gives no rule, window, secondary-stress or weight statement, so it does not alter the classification.
new_statements.rule_in_words: Word accent (stress) is contrastive and therefore lexically fixed per word; the minimal pairs place it on either the penult (k'ita 'see', 'ubos 'depleted') or the ultima (kit'a 'we incl.', ub'os 'lower area'). Its main phonetic cue is vowel length in open syllables and loudness in closed syllables; pitch is not a consistent cue. The dictionary marks accent with ['] (and [^] for accent plus glottal stop on the same syllable), but the practical orthography and ordinary texts do not mark it (sec. 1, p. 4). No default position and no weight condition is stated.
new_statements.exceptions: None stated for placement. Sec. 3 (p. 8) names 'accent shift' as one of the morphophonemic change types that occur when words or morphemes are joined, but the sketch gives no subsection or examples for it (the Rosetta scan of the Phonological Sketch runs through 3.4 Devoicing, then the Grammatical Sketch begins on p. 11).
new_statements.identity_note: Wolfenden 2001, Introduction sec. 5 'Dialects of Masbatenyo' : the dictionary 'is a record of speech as spoken in northern Masbate primarily in and around the capital town of Masbate', the northern dialect that serves as the provincial lingua franca (300,000-350,000 speakers); western (Balud) and southern (Cataingin) dialects and Ticao varieties are named but not described. The accent statement therefore describes the northern/Masbate-town dialect.

sources.quote: 'inherited length is never found on the ultima, and in most Bs dialects (except Mas, Sor, N-S, S-L, War) is restricted to the penult. All Bs speech varieties except some dialects of Kuy and Tsg retain phonemic accent. The following minimal pair is found in all dialects ... punuq [pU:nuq] tree trunk : punuq [punuq] full' (the same pair Rosero gives as (9)). Mas = Masbateño in Zorc's dialect abbreviations.
